name: Mutations
title: Mutations: every gene the nightly run built for you, its card, your decisions, mutations, questions and how it is learned

permissions: switches a gene the nightly run built on when you keep it and off when you turn it off, through its own feature switch
keeps your mutation requests for the next night to build, through its usual tests and land.sh, within the night's caps
asks a model your questions about a gene, with that gene's record only (Models, Questions about a gene)
offers a kept gene in your own chats at its moment, at most three a day; switches off an ask-for-it gene unused in its trial week, with a notice and Keep anyway
books ten minutes on Clockwork for a gene that changes how you work, when you pick a time
starts a run that takes a gene's code out, only when you press Reject and say why
reads every change that lands in Rouh's code and puts it to a gene, asking a model when its commit does not say (Models, Writing the gene log)
counts each person's uses of each gene from the event log, and asks a model once a month how useful the genes they used are (Models, How useful a gene is)
starts a run that takes a gene out as its contract says, only when an administrator presses Take it out in the gene log
drafts a gene's contract from a conversation when you ask, and grows it into Rouh with a run only when you say grow it (Genes on the fly, switch gene_drafts)
reads the nightly run's services.md, and never writes it, to name on a gene's card the outside services it brought in
turns a switch no gene has on or off when you press it under Other switches, in Passed
jobs: every fifteen minutes: nights brought in, trials judged by use, mutations and removals settled (evolution.tick)
every fifteen minutes: the gene log reads what landed and counts each gene's use, and from the 25th the model evaluates the month's genes (runtime._gene_log_loop)
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/evolution.py, rouh/gene_questions.py, rouh/web/evolution.py, evolutionpage.js and evolutionpage.css (with Other switches; every switch stays where it is), the Evolution layer in index.html, GeneSource in decision_sources.py, the gene_offer tool and the offers line in brain.py, and drop the tables mutations_genes, mutations_gene_events, gene_mutations and gene_questions; every gene's own feature switch stays where it is. The gene log goes with it: turn its switches gene_log and gene_usage off, or drop its six tables with a migration and delete rouh/genelog.py, rouh/geneuse.py, rouh/web/genelog.py and genelogpage.js/.css.
